label: Case Study
subtitle: A tailored learning experience designed for mid-to-senior leadership to synchronize corporate vision with frontline execution.

problem.label: The Gap
problem.heading: Leaders were informing, not influencing.
problem.description: Strategic intent was lost in translation. Executives communicated data instead of direction, creating misalignment between vision and execution across teams.

steps.title: Stakeholder Analysis
steps.subtitle: Mapping Power-Interest Grids to decode influence dynamics.
body: Before designing a single slide or scenario, we mapped the organizational influence topology. Using adapted Mendelow Power-Interest Grids, we identified the critical stakeholder archetypes each leader would face: the skeptical board member, the overwhelmed middle manager, the disengaged cross-functional partner.
This analysis drove the scenario branching logic. Every simulation pathway corresponds to a real stakeholder archetype, ensuring practice transfers directly to the boardroom.

steps.title: The Pyramid Principle
steps.subtitle: Applying Barbara Minto's structural logic for message clarity.
body: Most leaders bury the lead. They narrate chronologically when their audience needs the conclusion first. We restructured communication patterns using the Pyramid Principle: lead with the recommendation, support with grouped arguments, ground each argument in evidence.

The simulation enforces this structure. Learners who present bottom-up receive realistic pushback from virtual stakeholders. Those who lead with strategic framing see immediate alignment in the simulation's response metrics.

steps.title: Branching Simulations
steps.subtitle: Real-world scenarios for risk-free strategic practice.
body: Each scenario places the learner in a high-stakes communication moment: presenting a restructuring plan to the board, aligning a resistant sales team on a new go-to-market strategy, or delivering a difficult performance narrative to a senior stakeholder.
The branching engine tracks three dimensions: strategic clarity, audience resonance, and decisiveness. Immediate feedback surfaces blind spots without the career consequences of learning on the job.

simulation.label: The Strategy Lab
simulation.heading: Step into the boardroom.
simulation.description: An interactive branching simulation built in Articulate Storyline 360. Navigate high-stakes communication scenarios where every word shapes outcomes.
